H12.description: With chunkImportMap enabled, preload dependencies injected in generateBundle after hashing are not reflected in chunk hashes, so a chunk's content changes while its hashed file name stays the same (stale cache).
H12.reason: agreed defect (verdict, severity, category); anchors: the union of both annotators' sites across H10-H12 (the hooks at 315-318 where the per-environment graph must be collected, 331-333 where the hash augmentation belongs); description B's wording, which names the consequence

H13.description: When pure CSS chunks are removed from the bundle, their entries are left in the import map, which then points at files that do not exist.
H13.reason: agreed defect (anchors, severity, category); B's D3 is A's D2 (removed pure-CSS chunks left in the emitted import map)

H14.description: In the no-preload path (e.g. SSR) the import specifier is checked against removed pure CSS files without first being mapped through the import map, so with chunkImportMap the dynamic import of a removed CSS chunk is never replaced by Promise.resolve.
H14.reason: B's split kept: in the no-preload path the specifier is not mapped through the import map, so the dynamic import of a removed CSS chunk is never rewritten — a second wrong behaviour, distinct from the stale import-map entries (H13); one wrong behaviour per group; anchors, severity, category agreed

H15.description: Removes the getImportMap call here because the D2 fix moves it earlier.

H17.description: Replaces the inline addDeps traversal with the shared collectPreloadDependencies helper so preload deps match the hash signatures; behaviour is essentially the same (the import rewrite now happens once).

I02.description: The css post plugin decides whether to generate a sourcemap from the top-level config.build.sourcemap rather than the environment's build.sourcemap, so per-environment sourcemap settings are ignored.
I02.reason: head css.ts:991 reads config.build.sourcemap (the top-level config) where the later fix reads this.environment.config.build.sourcemap: the wrong behaviour is present at head in a fixture file (codebook: the head file the incident cites), so defect-at-head (A); B's not-at-head rests on the incident being unrelated to the PR's own change, which the codebook does not require; anchor corrected from A's 988 to the line holding the condition; category logic (an incident-only defect needs one)
